run_fixed_point_plot: run the script to generate a fixed-point visualization plot and save it as fp.pdf
run_numerical_fixed_point: run the script to numerically find fixed points where y equals x using numpy
run_matplotlib_scatter_plot: run the script to create a matplotlib scatter plot marking fixed-point locations with star markers
run_pdf_figure_export: run the script to export a cropped PDF figure with transparent background using pdfcrop
run_sine_cosine_function_plot: run the script to plot a sine and cosine composite function against the identity line
